arxiv-2101-01467.title: Stability of constant steady states of a chemotaxis model
arxiv-2101-01467.creator: Szymon Cygan ID, Grzegorz Karch ID, Krzysztof Krawczyk ID, Hiroshi Wakui ID
arxiv-2101-01467.description: Abstract . The Cauchy problem for the parabolic–elliptic Keller–Segel system in the whole n n -dimensional space is studied. For this model, every constant A ∈ ℝ A\in\mathbb{R} is a stationary solution. The main goal of this work is to show that A < 1 A<1 is a stable steady state while A > 1 A>1 is unstable.

arxiv-2107-04178.title: Semantic Feature Matching for Robust Mapping in Agriculture
arxiv-2107-04178.creator: Mohamad Qadri, George Kantor
arxiv-2107-04178.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mohamad Qadri, George Kantor. Visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) systems are an essential component in agricultural robotics that enable autonomous navigation and the construction of accurate 3D maps of agricultural fields. However, lack of texture, varying illumination conditions, and lack of structure in the environment pose a challenge for Visual-SLAM systems that rely on traditional feature extraction and matching algorithms such as ORB or SIFT.

arxiv-2108-06113.title: UMFA: A photorealistic style transfer method based on U-Net and multi-layer feature aggregation
arxiv-2108-06113.creator: Dongyu Rao, Xiao-Jun Wu, Hui Li, Josef Kittler, Tianyang Xu
arxiv-2108-06113.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a photorealistic style transfer network to emphasize the natural effect of photorealistic image stylization. In general, distortion of the image content and lacking of details are two typical issues in the style transfer field.

arxiv-2110-11842.title: Multi-view Contrastive Graph Clustering
arxiv-2110-11842.creator: Erlin Pan, Zhao Kang
arxiv-2110-11842.description: Abstract With the explosive growth of information technology, multi-view graph data have become increasingly prevalent and valuable. Most existing multi-view clustering techniques either focus on the scenario of multiple graphs or multi-view attributes. In this paper, we propose a generic framework to cluster multi-view attributed graph data.

arxiv-2301-09784.creator: Yu Li, and, Bing Wang
arxiv-2301-09784.description: Abstract In this paper, we prove that any Kähler Ricci shrinker surface has bounded sectional curvature. arxiv-2409-10622.title: Quasi-periodic γ \gamma -ray modulations in the blazars PKS 2155-83 and PKS 2255-282
arxiv-2409-10622.creator: M. A. Hashad, Amr A. EL-Zant, Y. Abdou, H. M. Badran
arxiv-2409-10622.description: Abstract While there has been an increase in interest in the possibility of quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs) in blazars, the search has hitherto been restricted to sources with well-sampled light curves. Objects with light curves that include gaps have been, to our knowledge, overlooked.

arxiv-2410-05158.title: Floquet engineering of topological semimetals with bicircularly polarized light
arxiv-2410-05158.creator: Maitri Ganguli, Aneek Jana, Awadhesh Narayan
arxiv-2410-05158.description: Abstract We study the effect of illumination of bicircularly polarized light (BCL) on topological semimetals, namely multifold fermion and line-node semimetals. We demonstrate, by means of both low-energy and lattice models, that the band-structures of both multifold fermions and line-node semimetal exhibit rich features with BCL illumination.

arxiv-2411-15352.title: Impact of consumer preferences on decarbonization of transport sector in India
arxiv-2411-15352.creator: Nandita Saraf, Yogendra Shastri
arxiv-2411-15352.description: Abstract Decarbonization of transport sector through adoption of cleaner vehicle options will depend on the environmental awareness of consumers and their priorities. This work develops and uses a system dynamics approach to understand possible adoption pathways of novel vehicle options, i.e., ethanol-blended fuel (E85), electric, and compressed natural gas (CNG) vehicles in India.

arxiv-2510-07867.title: On the Optimality of the Median-of-Means Estimator under Adversarial Contamination
arxiv-2510-07867.creator: Xabier de Juan, Santiago Mazuelas
arxiv-2510-07867.description: Abstract The Median-of-Means (MoM) is a robust estimator widely used in machine learning that is known to be (minimax) optimal in scenarios where samples are i.i.d. In more grave scenarios, samples are contaminated by an adversary that can inspect and modify the data. Previous work has theoretically shown the suitability of the MoM estimator in certain contaminated settings.

arxiv-2511-19296.title: Fractional Laplacian in bended strip
arxiv-2511-19296.creator: Fedor Bakharev, Sergey Matveenko
arxiv-2511-19296.description: Abstract Abstract. The spectral properties of the restricted fractional Laplacian with Dirichlet boundary conditions in a smoothly bent waveguide is investigated. The existence of eigenvalues below the threshold of the continuous spectrum is proved, generalizing classical results known for the local Laplace operator. Our approach utilizes the Caffarelli–Silvestre extension, addressing the specific geometric difficulties arising from the operator non-locality.

pmc-11478800.title: Biochemical and Proteomic Analyses in Drought-Tolerant Wheat Mutants Obtained by Gamma Irradiation
pmc-11478800.creator: Ayşe Şen, Tamer Gümüş, Aslıhan Temel, İrfan Öztürk, Özge Çelik, Pedro Diaz-Vivancos
pmc-11478800.description: The bread wheat cultivar (Triticum aestivum L. cv. Sagittario) as a parental line and its mutant, drought-tolerant lines (Mutant lines 4 and 5) were subjected to polyethylene glycol (PEG)-induced drought. Drought stress resulted in decreased chlorophyll levels and the accumulation of proline and TBARS, despite increases in activities of catalase, peroxidase, and superoxide dismutase enzymes.

pmc-12655602.title: Electrochemical Performance of Dysprosium-Doped Strontium Cobaltite with Perovskite Structure
pmc-12655602.creator: Sergey N Vereshchagin, Vyacheslav A Dudnikov, Sergey M Zharkov, Galina M Zeer, Leonid A Solovyov, Elias Stathatos
pmc-12655602.description: The electrochemical properties of the dysprosium-doped strontium cobaltite SDC (Sr0.8Dy0.2CoO3−δ) were evaluated for possible application as pseudocapacitor electrode materials. Dense perovskite SDC ceramics were prepared using standard solid-state synthesis techniques. The SDC sample was characterized using XRD, structural analysis, SEM/EDS, and simultaneous thermal analysis.

pmc-13122657.title: Pre-analytical stability of blood samples transported by drone versus ground: a pilot study
pmc-13122657.creator: Marie Brionne, Laure Peyro-Saint-Paul, Jean-Jacques Dutheil, Denis Vivien, Hélène Legros, Simon Le Hello, Rémy Morello
pmc-13122657.description: ObjectivesPre-analytical conditions are critical to ensure the reliability of laboratory results, as emphasized by ISO 15189 standards. Drone transport has emerged as a promising alternative to conventional logistics, but its impact on sample integrity remains insufficiently characterized. This pilot study aimed to assess the pre-analytical stability of blood samples transported by drone versus ground transport.

pmc-13334458.title: Effects of Nanocellulose on the Physicochemical‐Digestive Characteristics of Corn Starch
pmc-13334458.creator: Yanyan Liu, Shuyao Li, Junjie Yuan, Huiying Zhang, Xueli Gao, Yonghui Wang, Shenghua He, Weiyun Guo, Guanghui Li
pmc-13334458.description: This study investigated the effects of nanocellulose (NC) on the physicochemical properties, multi‐scale structure, and in vitro digestibility of corn starch (CS). The results showed that NC complexed with CS through non‐covalent bonds, and the absorbance ratio of 1047 to 1022 cm−1 increased from 0.38 to 0.72 with increasing NC content.

pmc-13448045.title: Spinopelvic Parameters, Degree of Correction, and Proximal Junctional Complications After Adult Spinal Deformity Surgery: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
pmc-13448045.creator: HyungSub Jin, Kyung-Soo Suk, Byung Ho Lee, Si Young Park, Hak-Sun Kim, Seong-Hwan Moon, Sub-Ri Park, Namhoo Kim, Jae Won Shin, Ji-Won Kwon
pmc-13448045.description: ObjectiveProximal junctional kyphosis (PJK) is a frequent postoperative complication following adult spinal deformity (ASD) surgery, whereas proximal junctional failure (PJF) is a less common but clinically more severe complication. Spinopelvic radiographic parameters have been associated with the development of these complications, yet existing studies have reported inconsistent results.

pmc-13556838.title: 501. 2-year real-world clinical outcomes of vagus nerve stimulation for higher-grade treatment-resistant depression
pmc-13556838.creator: Y Domany, K Feffer, I Straus, Z Feldman, A Solomon, E Blomhof-Bris, R Nega, G Gal, A Hadar
pmc-13556838.description: BackgroundMajor depressive disorder (MDD) is a leading cause of disability. Despite multiple treatment strategies, a substantial proportion of patients do not achieve adequate symptom relief. This subgroup is known as treatment-resistant depression (TRD) and poses clinical and challenges. Among them, individuals with higher-grade TRD (HG-TRD)—defined as failure of at least four adequate treatment interventions—have limited treatment options.

pmc-13630556.title: Courtship vocalizations of male mice do not always attract females
pmc-13630556.creator: Maja Peng, Martina Zani, Reyhaneh Abbasi, Peter Balazs, Dustin J. Penn, Sarah M. Zala
pmc-13630556.description: Male house mice (Mus musculus) emit ultrasonic vocalizations (USVs) during courtship and mating, which influence their copulatory success. Several studies have found that playbacks of male USVs attract females, though this response may depend on the presence of male scent, and one study suggested that females are more attracted to complex than simple USV types.
